definitions.full: H2273. chabrah [ חַבְרָה ] noun feminine fellow ; — plural suffix חַבְרָתַ֑הּ Dan 7:20 its fellows (in vision of horns).

occurrences.englishText: and concerning the ten horns that were on its head, and the other horn which came up, and before which three fell, even that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spoke great things, whose look was more stout than its fellows.
